key_insight: This survey maps deep-learning methods for multi-label image classification into six clear categories and shows how modern models have improved visual recognition and label-relationship modeling.
clinical_relevance: In medical imaging, these advances can support more reliable detection of multiple findings in a single image, which may help triage, interpretation, and decision support.
method: Reviewed deep-learning MLIC approaches using CNNs, RNNs, and Transformers.
Organized the literature into six groups: region-, label-, architecture-, representation-, learning-, and data-oriented methods.
Summarized background elements such as datasets, backbones, and evaluation metrics.
evidence_signal: The paper is a survey rather than a new clinical study, and its evidence comes from comparing methods across datasets and standard evaluation metrics.
watch_item: Performance gains in benchmark datasets may not transfer directly to heterogeneous clinical imaging settings without careful validation.
paper_title: Rethinking Multi-Label Image Classification With Deep Learning: Taxonomy, Challenge, and Outlook
